purpose: Defines a configuration data model for TSN usecase generation, including topology parameters, stream generation constraints, placement strategies, routing modes, and dataset-driven configuration loading. It is the central configuration source for topology creation, stream generation, and scheduling behavior.

Holds all configuration parameters required to generate a TSN experiment, including topology structure, link characteristics, stream generation constraints, placement policies, routing behavior, and dataset-based experiment definitions.
responsibilities: Store topology generation parameters (graph type, hosts, switches, link properties)
Store stream generation constraints (period, payload, frames, latency)
Control placement strategies (stride, staggered, hotspot)
Define routing behavior (fixed path vs shortest path)
Support loading from config files and CSV datasets
Serialize and deserialize configuration to/from INI format

data_sections.topology_config: Defines network structure including number of hosts/switches, port speed, propagation/processing delay, link bandwidth, queueing, and graph generation type (fat-tree, random, line)
data_sections.streams_config: Defines stream generation constraints such as number of streams, period range, frame size range, payload size range, and latency constraints
data_sections.routing: Controls routing behavior including fixed-path mode and shortest-path preference

placement_strategies.stride: Selects hosts using a fixed step pattern in index space, optionally increasing selection spacing to spread load deterministically
placement_strategies.staggered: Biases placement toward structured locality (edge/pod-based grouping) to cluster traffic near network regions
placement_strategies.hotspot: Increases probability of reusing previously selected or popular hosts to simulate hotspot traffic concentration

data_sections.expiration: Defines whether streams are finite in duration and their lifecycle bounds in cycles
data_sections.generation: Controls whether stream generation is incremental or batch-based

purpose: Builds a UsecaseConfig instance from an INI-style configuration file parsed via ConfigParser, mapping topology and stream parameters into structured dataclass fields.
responsibilities: Parse topology configuration section
Parse stream configuration section
Convert string-encoded dictionaries using ast.literal_eval
Handle flexible formats for max latency range (scalar or list)

example_usage.setup:
import configparser
from usecase_config import UsecaseConfig
cfg = configparser.RawConfigParser()
cfg.read('uc_config.ini')

purpose: Converts a UsecaseConfig instance back into an INI-style ConfigParser object for persistence or export.
responsibilities: Serialize topology configuration fields into INI format
Serialize stream configuration fields into INI format
Handle list vs scalar encoding for max latency range
Preserve dictionary-based configuration structures as strings

purpose: Generates multiple UsecaseConfig instances from a CSV dataset, mapping each row into a full experiment configuration with topology, stream, routing, and placement settings.
responsibilities: Parse experiment rows from CSV
Map topology types to graph configurations
Convert experiment parameters into stream constraints
Configure placement strategies (stride, staggered, hotspot)
Set routing and GA mode behavior
Return a list of independent configuration objects

returns.description: List of generated configuration objects for experiments

Parse INI structure using ConfigParser
Convert into UsecaseConfig instance
